paragraph: Alpine is a single-tier market and a thin one. Five single-family sales over six months, median $4,500,000, with a range from $4,000,000 to over $7.3 million. The median is the better guide than any one sale here. Sale-to-list ratio came in at 0.96, nothing sold above asking, and the median days on market was 101. That is a buyer-friendly setup, and sellers at this level are generally okay with waiting for the right buyer rather than cutting price to move fast. Five closings across six months is too small a sample to read a monthly trend, so the seasonal arc that shapes most of Bergen County tells you little about Alpine. What matters more is your patience, your financing, and how narrow the buyer pool is for any given house at this price.
